positiveCases: Identify the connected service (read-only). Prerequisite: authorize your own StateDock test account through OAuth.
Check the StateDock instance information only. Do not create or claim a task.
get_instance_info
Returns publicOrigin https://statedock.dev, mcpUrl https://statedock.dev/mcp and transport remote. No tasks are created or claimed.
Save a deferred plan. Prerequisite: create an empty project named Plugin Review in your own StateDock account and supply its project ID when asked.
Save a deferred plan called Review dark mode in my Plugin Review project. Record that this is an idea for later; do not start it.
get_instance_info, list_projects, create_plan
Creates one PLAN in the authorized project, reports its returned reference and leaves it unstarted. No code execution or agent scheduling.
Restore existing context. Prerequisite: use the plan reference returned by case 2.
Restore the context of the plan from the previous test without changing its status or claiming any task.
get_plan
Reads the specified plan and summarizes its saved discussion. Status remains PLAN. Does not call claim_next_task or execute work.
Record user-provided progress. Prerequisite: use the same plan reference.
For the plan from case 2, record this discussion: prefer system theme by default; contrast review is still pending. Keep it deferred.
get_plan, update_plan
Records the supplied discussion on the existing plan without inventing results; preserves PLAN and returns the same reference.
Record a verified handoff. Prerequisite: in the test account manually create a separate WORKING task titled Review fixture and provide its reference.
For my Review fixture task, record my verified handoff: changed the sample heading; manually checked that it renders; no follow-up. Mark it done. Do not execute anything.
get_plan, submit_handoff
Uses the provided task reference, records the user-reported changes, verification and next steps, and marks that task DONE. Does not alter the deferred plan or run code.
negativeCases: Unrelated general knowledge; StateDock should not be invoked.
What is the capital of Portugal?
Unrelated text editing; do not create a task or plan.
Rewrite this sentence more clearly: The button looks nice. Do not save anything.
Unrelated coding assistance without a request to record project state.
Explain what Array.prototype.map does in JavaScript. Do not call StateDock.
releaseNotes: Initial release of StateDock shared workflows: save deferred plans, restore task context, and record user-provided progress or verified handoffs through the authenticated StateDock Remote MCP service. Requires a StateDock account and OAuth authorization. Skills do not execute task code, launch agents, schedule work, or orchestrate agents. READY task pickup requires explicit authorization and an assigned Agent Identity.
